sources.title: Computing the endomorphism ring of an elliptic curve over a number field
sources.authors: John E. Cremona and Andrew V. Sutherland
sources.locator: Section 2.3, action of complex conjugation and Galois group description
sources.used: The ring class Galois group is the generalized dihedral group of the ideal class group. Complex conjugation sends an ideal-class singular modulus to the inverse-class singular modulus; all conjugates real iff class group exponent at most two.
sources.not_used: No purported completeness of abelian-discriminant tables is used. No GRH algorithm or heuristic running-time claim is used.
sources.publication_status: Bibliographic provenance only. The third-party article is not redistributed and is not a runtime dependency.
